title: Missing a Body?
summary: A woman walks into the station confessing to have shot her husband. The team thinks it's a closed case but DI Poole investigates further.
method: The husband was only grazed when his wife shot him. He woke up and staggered over to his friend's house where they got into an argument and he was shot dead. The body was transported elsewhere later and it was the button that led the team to the killer. The killer committed the murder in the short time between when he was released from jail and when the cops showed up at his door.
motive: The victim was going to reveal an affair to the killer's wife. The victim was about to reveal that his friend was having an affair with his wife because text messages were discovered.
notes: ongoing joke that DI Poole has a crush on the suspect.
